build_task_with_define_task: use @define_task decorator to register a PHYRE task definition function that builds a scene
create_box_with_add_box: call C.add_box(width, height) to create a box body in the PHYRE scene
position_body_set_bottom: chain .set_bottom(y) on a body to position it by its bottom edge coordinate
position_body_set_left: chain .set_left(x) on a body to position it by its left edge coordinate
define_goal_update_task: call C.update_task(body1, body2, relationships=[C.SpatialRelationship.NOT_TOUCHING]) to set the task goal
